description: This file defines the HarRouter class responsible for handling HTTP request routing based on HAR files within the Playwright testing framework. It includes methods for creating, managing, and disposing of HAR-based routes, and handles request interception, redirection, fulfillment, and error logging.

classes.name: HarRouter
classes.description: Class for managing HAR-based request routing, including creation, request handling, and disposal.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Static method to asynchronously create a HarRouter instance by opening a HAR file.

methods.name: addContextRoute
methods.description: Adds a route to a BrowserContext to handle requests matching the specified URL pattern.

methods.name: addPageRoute
methods.description: Adds a route to a Page to handle requests matching the specified URL pattern.

methods.name: [Symbol.asyncDispose]
methods.description: Asynchronous disposal method to clean up resources.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Closes the HAR file and cleans up resources.
